import { format } from './format.a';
import { Linter } from '../lint/lint.ts';
import { Settings } from '../lint/settings.ts';
import { Parser } from '../../typescript/parser/parser.ts';
import { Scanner } from '../../typescript/scanner/scanner.ts';
const source = 'debugger;';
const parser = new Parser(source, 'probe.ts');
const scanner = new Scanner(source);
const lint = new Linter(source, parser, scanner, 'no-debugger', '', '', false, new Settings());
lint.run();
console.log(`${lint.findings.length}`);
const result = format('probe.json', '{}');
console.log(result.kind === 'Ok' ? result.text : result.message);
